lines.beaver: 민수야, 근데 네 본명이 민수 맞아?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, is Minsu actually your real name?
lines.beaver_roman: minsuya, geunde ne bonmyeongi minsu maja?
lines.en: No, my real name is Kim Minhyeok. Minsu is a nickname.

lines.beaver: 진짜? 십 년 동안 몰랐네. 왜 말 안 했어?
lines.beaver_en: Really? I didn't know for ten years. Why didn't you tell me?
lines.beaver_roman: jinjja? sim nyeon dongan mollanne. wae mal an haesseo?
lines.learner: 다들 알겠거니 하고 말을 안 했지.
lines.en: I assumed everyone knew, so I didn't say.
lines.roman: dadeul algetgeoni hago mareul an haetji.

lines.beaver_en: Then do you use your real name on social media?
lines.en: No, instead of my real name I use 'Humble Minsu.'

lines.beaver: 하하, 소인이 뭐야. 나이는 어떻게 돼?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, soini mwoya. naineun eotteoke dwae?
lines.en: I was born in '96. I'm two years younger than you.

lines.beaver_en: Huh? I assumed we were the same age.
lines.learner: 다들 그래. 내가 좀 나이 들어 보이잖아.
lines.en: Everyone does. I look a bit older, you know.
lines.roman: dadeul geurae. naega jom nai deureo boijana.

lines.beaver: 아니야, 젊어 보여. 혈액형도 물어봐도 돼?
lines.beaver_en: No, you look young. Can I ask your blood type too?
lines.beaver_roman: aniya, jeolmeo boyeo. hyeoraekyeongdo mureobwado dwae?
lines.en: Type A. Everyone else in my family is type B, though.

lines.beaver: 요즘 무슨 일 해? 바쁘다고 들었어.
lines.beaver_en: What do you do these days? I heard you're busy.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum museun il hae? bappeudago deureosseo.
lines.learner: 남녀노소 다 듣는 라디오 프로그램을 만들어.
lines.en: I make a radio show that people of all ages listen to.
lines.roman: namnyeonoso da deunneun radio peurogeuraemeul mandeureo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, which age group listens most?
lines.en: Mostly college students in their twenties.
She's a cheerful person nicknamed 'Radio Girl.'

lines.beaver: 오늘 너에 대해 많이 알았다. 다음에 또 보자.
lines.beaver_en: I learned a lot about you today. See you next time.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul neoe daehae mani aratda. daeume tto boja.
lines.learner: 그래, 이제 민혁이라고 불러 줘. 잘 가!
lines.en: Okay, call me Minhyeok from now on. Bye!
lines.roman: geurae, ije minhyeogirago bulleo jwo. jal ga!
